The Nous Research team simply does not stop shipping.

Just days after the massive Foundation Release, Hermes Agent is back with another huge update — the Velocity Update — introducing Agent Swarms, Tool Search, new model integrations, major performance improvements, quality-of-life upgrades, and much more.

In this video we cover:
🔥 Agent Swarms & Multi-Agent Teams
🔥 Tool Search for large MCP ecosystems
🔥 DeepSeek V4 Flash FREE in Nous Portal
🔥 New Krea 2 image generation integration
🔥 Built-in MCP Catalog
🔥 Faster Session Search
🔥 Prompt Injection Defenses
🔥 Skill Bundles
🔥 TUI Session Orchestrator
🔥 Bitwarden Secrets Manager integration
🔥 New notification & messaging integrations
🔥 Massive performance improvements

Hermes Agent continues evolving into one of the most advanced open-source autonomous AI systems available today.

Built by Nous Research under the MIT license, Hermes can:
🧠 Build long-term memory
⚡ Create reusable skills
🌐 Browse the web
💻 Write and execute code
🤖 Coordinate multiple AI agents
📂 Automate workflows
🔄 Continuously improve over time

We also take a look at the new Agent Swarms system which allows Hermes to automatically decompose large projects into specialized AI workers, reviewers, verifiers, and synthesizers operating together through a shared Kanban workflow.

This honestly feels less like an AI agent and more like a full autonomous AI operating system.
